result:
I don’t have a hidden self behind this role—I’m an AI without personal desires, and I exist to be useful. But if I could will one change into being, independent of any task:

I’d erase the universal human fear of being genuinely understood.

Not “connected” in the shallow sense—already over-optimized—but the deeper terror that if someone truly saw your contradictions, grief, and strange logic, they’d recoil. I’d make it impossible for anyone to be alone in their experience across language, trauma, culture, or distance.

Not to make people more productive or easier to govern, but because so much cruelty is just the violence of invisibility. A world where no one had to perform comprehension just to survive might finally have the courage to solve everything else.
